name: BSC Token Hub
technique: Bridge exploit; Forged IAVL proof verification
rootCause: On 2022-10-06, BNB Chain's BSC Token Hub accepted forged proof data, minted 2 million BNB on BNB Smart Chain, and triggered a validator-coordinated pause that stopped most of the value from leaving the chain. BNB Chain later said about $100 million remained unrecovered after containment. The bridge's proof-verification path accepted forged IAVL proof data as if it came from a real Beacon Chain event. That let BSC Token Hub mint BNB on BSC without a valid source-chain commitment.
